answer: Another defense throttles throughput with sequential proofs. Every agent must solve a chain of memory-hard puzzles before its answers count, and puzzles in a chain must be solved one after another, like picking fruit row by row through an orchard rather than all at once. An honest node spends time roughly equal to its quota, flowing steadily like a river. An attacker spawning clones cannot parallelize the chain, so each extra fake identity buys no extra output while paying full compute cost. Honest agents prove one thread of sequential work, making sybil multiplication pointless.
